requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Applicant's age at the time of the offence, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Applicant's age at the time of the offence, from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the age at the offence is the route's threshold fact and lives on the participant's own record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how old you were when you committed the offence - this route is only open where it was before you turned 25

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Superior Court unit named in the caption - the county whose court had jurisdiction over the proceeding
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Superior Court unit named in the caption - the county whose court had jurisdiction over the proceeding
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the court having jurisdiction is a case fact the participant establishes from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which county's Superior Court, Criminal Division, handled the case - the Criminal Division clerk's office there can confirm it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Docket number of the proceeding sought to be sealed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Docket number of the proceeding sought to be sealed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the docket number, copied from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of final discharge, shown by the court's record of final discharge
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of final discharge, shown by the court's record of final discharge
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no discharge fact is held for this record, and the two-year requirement of Sec. 5119(g)(1) runs from it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of your final discharge - the day you finished everything the sentence required - checked against the record of final discharge from the Criminal Division; it establishes the date the two-year clock ran from

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The applicant's own account of rehabilitation since final discharge, on the application's own lines
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The applicant's own account of rehabilitation since final discharge, on the application's own lines
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the controlling review lists rehabilitation evidence on the under-25 route among the fields that must not be auto-completed; the platform prompts and never writes
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own account, in your own words, of what you have done since discharge - work, study, treatment, family, community; the Court has to be satisfied about rehabilitation, the burden is yours, and the prompts page may help you decide what to say; check what you say against whatever material you choose to gather

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the applicant on the application
protectedBlanks.why: the applicant signs the application personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the applicant's signature on the application
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the application is signed would be false
